author: scrum-master-agent

sprint.sprint_goal: Prove Dashanan's core memory loop end to end - orchestrated write/read through Working and Episodic Memory, hybrid retrieval, provenance-gated writes, and Memory-Score-driven Active->Compressed rotation - on the exact FR slice both the corrected WSJF ranking and the HLD's independent architecture-fitness check converge on without adjustment.
sprint.scope_source: pm-wsjf-revalidation.md Section 5 (WSJF ranks 1-7 exact match) + HLD.md Section 12F (independent architecture-fitness confirmation)

dependency_graph.note: See backlog_draft.json dependency_graph for the full per-story adjacency list and promotion_reason.

risk_flags.description: OAQ-4 (Zone 2 capacity cap + MaxAge forced archival) is a hard Sprint 1 dependency per HLD Section 12F, not an optional nice-to-have, because Zone 8 (Archived destination) is out of scope and items would otherwise dwell in Compressed unbounded. Explicitly scoped as its own story (not folded silently into DASH-STORY-003 or DASH-STORY-009) so it cannot be dropped under sprint pressure.

Importance term has no data source in Sprint 1 (Zone 4/Procedural, which supplies inferred salience, is out of scope). Mitigated by an explicit-tag-only default of 0.5 per HLD Section 12F recommendation; carried into future_sprints_backlog against FR-004 in backlog_draft.json so the gap is revisited when Zone 4 ships.

DASH-STORY-001 (Orchestrator, 8 SP) and DASH-STORY-007 (Retrieval-Index, 8 SP) and DASH-STORY-008 (Memory Score engine, 8 SP) are the three largest stories and sit at build-order groups 1, 3, and 4 respectively - not concentrated in a single sprint half. No single dependency chain forces more than 3 of the 5 build-order groups to run serially through one specialization (orchestration/backend), so the sequencing does not appear to concentrate overload on one sub-team. Flagged for the Scrum Master to confirm against actual team composition before Sprint 1 kickoff, since this plan does not have live team-capacity data (per scrum-framework-core Operating Rule 3 - capacity CI is a Phase 6 SP.2+ activity requiring historical velocity data not yet available for a Sprint 1 draft).

52 total Sprint 1 story points is an unvalidated draft estimate (SP.0, no historical velocity or Focus Factor data exists yet for this team). Per scrum-framework-core M3, Focus Factor bootstrap CI requires >=6 historical sprints; none exist pre-Sprint-1. This total should NOT be treated as a committed capacity number until SP.2-SP.4 context-map and estimation passes run against real team capacity.

notes: Corrected WSJF ranking (pm-wsjf-revalidation.md) produced an exact match to the locked Sprint 1 scope with no promotion needed - ranks 1-7 are precisely {FR-001, FR-010, FR-002, FR-009, FR-007, FR-006, FR-012}, so dependency_graph.promotion_reason in backlog_draft.json documents only the structural build-order dependency (Zone 1 as root), not a WSJF-driven scope change.

HLD Section 12F's two flagged gaps (Importance default-to-0.5, and archive-has-no-destination) are both carried into this sprint plan as explicit stories/risk flags rather than silently absorbed, per the mandate not to ignore the Zone 8/OAQ-4 dependency.
